sloka: प्रवादः सत्य एवायं त्वां प्रति प्रायशो नृप ।पतिव्रतानां नाकस्मात् पतन्त्यश्रूणि भूतले ।। ६.११४.६७ ।।
transliteration: pravādaḥ satya evāyaṁ tvāṁ prati prāyaśo nṛpa ।pativratānāṁ nākasmāt patantyaśrūṇi bhūtale ।। 6.114.67 ।।

translations.english: "King! Chaste women of noble lineage being righteous, serving the elders have been widowed by you. Because of their curse, you have fallen under the sway of your enemy and because of that, this has come to you."
